montserrat.title: Flag of Montserrat
desc: - A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of Montserrat in the fly
- The arms depict a woman in green, Erin, embracing a black cross and golden harp, reflecting the island's Irish heritage
trivia:
- Montserrat uses the Union Jack as it is a British Overseas Territory
- The island's flag includes the harp (Ireland's symbol) and cross-symbols
- Montserrat is partially uninhabitable due to volcanic activity from the Soufrière Hills volcano
